assessment.rationale: Strong scenario match: per-plane claim cards make partial claims explicit, separate local IDs from boundary identity, and pair provisional semantics with exact audit anchors and local ledger evidence. The design is strongest on auditability and layer clarity; the main gaps are the draft-path fallback for long-term authority and some capability/signature semantics still being note-level rather than fully structured.
strengths: Per-plane status values make partial conformance explicit instead of vague app-wide claims.
Separates authoritative boundary identity, wire-visible IDs, and local-only IDs.
Exact cited audit anchors give later auditors a precise immutable replay target.
Local append-only promise ledgers and break-witness rules preserve peer-local evidence under failure.
weaknesses: Draft path plus revision hash is weaker than a durable self-certifying boundary ID.
Capability, witness, and provisional signature-carriage claims still rely partly on prose notes.
The proposal improves honesty more than turnkey interop; Bob still depends on the draft spec for actual wire behavior.
risks: The field set could ossify into a de facto final app contract too early.
Exactly one audit anchor may be too rigid for claims backed by multiple linked artifacts.
Structured claims do not prevent dishonesty by themselves; they only make contradictions easier to audit.
open_questions: Is draft path plus revision hash plus provisional label sufficient until a frozen pCID exists?
Which claim-card fields must be mandatory across all planes, and which are plane-specific?
Should possession of a hash always be treated as non-authorization unless a separate capability artifact is named?
Should provisional signature-carriage and capability/witness claims get dedicated structured fields instead of free-form notes?
How are superseded or revoked claim cards discovered under sparse, partial knowledge?
assessment.authority_boundary: Evidence only; does not settle PromiseGrid design.

promotion.source_provenance_policy: Canonical storage identity fields were updated for discoverability; source.* fields intentionally preserve the exact proposal tree and file hashes scored by the LLM before promotion.
